The primary subject is a large adult bison facing forward-left, featuring a massive shoulder hump, dark shaggy fur on the forequarters, and lighter brown fur on the hindquarters. A second, smaller bison stands to the left, partially occluded, showing its rear and side. There is a noticeable white/grey textured patch on the chest/shoulder area of the main bison, which appears inconsistent with typical bison coloration.
